PREFIX = 'dec $resume_foreach(pstate, nat) : pstate

def $resume_foreach(S, n) = S -- if S.COMPLETION =/= BUDGET

dec $cursor_valid(pstate, pcursor*) : bool
def $cursor_valid(S, eps) = true
def $cursor_valid(S, (CURSOR n_table n_position) :: pcursor*) = ($heap_member(HARRAY n_table, S.ALLOCATIONS) /\ $(n_table < |S.ARRAYS|) /\ $(n_position <= S.ARRAYS[n_table].SERIAL) /\ $cursor_position(pcursor*, n_table) = eps /\ $cursor_valid(S, pcursor*))

dec $foreach_task_ids(ptask) : nat*
def $foreach_task_ids(AT porigin ptask) = $foreach_task_ids(ptask)
def $foreach_task_ids(FOREACH_NEXT n pnode statement porigin? z) = [n]
def $foreach_task_ids(ptask) = eps -- otherwise
dec $foreach_tasks_ids(ptask*) : nat*
def $foreach_tasks_ids(eps) = eps
def $foreach_tasks_ids(ptask :: ptask_tail*) = $foreach_task_ids(ptask) ++ $foreach_tasks_ids(ptask_tail*)
dec $foreach_ids(piterator*) : nat*
def $foreach_ids(eps) = eps
def $foreach_ids((ITERATOR n n_array b pcursor*) :: piterator*) = n :: $foreach_ids(piterator*)
dec $foreach_id_count(nat*, nat) : nat
def $foreach_id_count(eps, n) = 0
def $foreach_id_count(n :: n_tail*, n) = $(1 + $foreach_id_count(n_tail*, n))
def $foreach_id_count(n_other :: n_tail*, n) = $foreach_id_count(n_tail*, n) -- if n_other =/= n

dec $foreach_registry_valid(pstate, piterator*) : bool
def $foreach_registry_valid(S, eps) = true
def $foreach_registry_valid(S, (ITERATOR n n_array b pcursor*) :: piterator*) = ($(n < S.NEXTITER) /\ $foreach_id_count($foreach_tasks_ids(S.TODO), n) = 1 /\ $iterator_lookup(piterator*, n) = eps /\ $cursor_valid(S, pcursor*) /\ ($heap_member(HARRAY n_array, S.ALLOCATIONS) = ($cursor_position(pcursor*, n_array) =/= eps)) /\ $foreach_registry_valid(S, piterator*))

dec $foreach_origin_valid(pstate, porigin?) : bool
def $foreach_origin_valid(S, eps) = true
def $foreach_origin_valid(S, (porigin)) = ($origin_node(S.SOURCES, porigin) =/= eps)
dec $foreach_task_valid(pstate, ptask) : bool
def $foreach_task_valid(S, AT porigin ptask) = ($origin_accepts(S.SOURCES, porigin, ptask) /\ $foreach_task_valid(S, ptask))
def $foreach_task_valid(S, FOREACH_NEXT n pnode statement (porigin) z) = ($origin_node(S.SOURCES, porigin) = (statement) /\ $heap_member(pnode, S.ALLOCATIONS))
def $foreach_task_valid(S, ORIGIN_RETURN porigin?) = $foreach_origin_valid(S, porigin?)
def $foreach_task_valid(S, ptask) = true -- otherwise
dec $foreach_tasks_valid(pstate, ptask*) : bool
def $foreach_tasks_valid(S, eps) = true
def $foreach_tasks_valid(S, ptask :: ptask_tail*) = ($foreach_task_valid(S, ptask) /\ $foreach_tasks_valid(S, ptask_tail*))

dec $foreach_positions_valid(pentry*, pposition*, nat, nat) : bool
def $foreach_positions_valid(eps, eps, n_min, n_serial) = true
def $foreach_positions_valid((ENTRY pkey pitem) :: pentry*, (POSITION pkey n) :: pposition*, n_min, n_serial) = ($(n >= n_min) /\ $(n < n_serial) /\ $position_lookup(pposition*, pkey) = eps /\ $foreach_positions_valid(pentry*, pposition*, $(n + 1), n_serial))
def $foreach_positions_valid(pentry*, pposition*, n_min, n_serial) = false -- otherwise
dec $foreach_arrays_valid(parray*) : bool
def $foreach_arrays_valid(eps) = true
def $foreach_arrays_valid(parray :: parray_tail*) = ($foreach_positions_valid(parray.ITEMS, parray.POSITIONS, 0, parray.SERIAL) /\ $foreach_arrays_valid(parray_tail*))
dec $foreach_valid(pstate) : bool
def $foreach_valid(S) = ($foreach_registry_valid(S, S.ITERATORS) /\ |$foreach_tasks_ids(S.TODO)| = |S.ITERATORS| /\ $foreach_arrays_valid(S.ARRAYS) /\ $foreach_origin_valid(S, S.ORIGIN) /\ $foreach_tasks_valid(S, S.TODO))
